movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

abilities.name: Designer
abilities.effect: The user is adept at crafting clothes for itself out of common leaves. When activating this ability to create a leaf suit, the user may choose two Types; the user resists the chosen types one step further while wearing that suit. The user may only have one leaf suit at a time, and creating a new suit destroys the old one.

abilities.name: Full Guard
abilities.effect: You resist the triggering Damage one step further.
